capabilityLimits: Normal, pending-path and paid-queue branches use native single-player scenes in one retained app realm. The host-replacement branch requires two authenticated native clients and the actual API relay; its initial match is natural AI3, followed by a native AI2 next match in the surviving peer realm. No single-player fallback is permitted. These recipes are authored, not executed.
